description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on left and right facades. Kitchen at top-left of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Kitchen adjacent to left facade, well-lit cooking position. Cook faces wall, back to dining and seating. Living arrangement: kitchen top-left, dining top-center, seating top-right. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. TV visible in seating area. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Both bedrooms in lower private zone from corridor. No en-suite. Large corridor (14.5sqm) provides generous circulation. Single bedroom large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room in corridor zone, suitable for coats, bikes, laundry or utility storage. Entry from bottom. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples needing a spare room, people working from home.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children
